world.title: 'Unfriendly look, but we get along great': Trump posts old photo with Kim Jong Un
world.summary: US President Donald Trump posted a throwback photo with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Saturday, humorously noting their “unfriendly look” in the image. Trump emphasized that, despite appearances, the two leaders have a good relationship. The photo reflects their past interactions and ongoing diplomatic efforts, highlighting the complexities of US-North Korea relations.

world.title: West Asia war LIVE: Iran demands release of downed pilots as Qatar denies holding them
world.summary: Iran has demanded the release of pilots reportedly downed in the ongoing conflict, while Qatar has denied holding them. In Lebanon, Israeli airstrikes in the south resulted in 11 fatalities, including three children, marking the deadliest attacks since a June agreement aimed at reducing hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah. Lebanese leaders have condemned these strikes.

world.title: Iran President Pezeshkian greets PM Modi on Independence Day, calls historic ties with India ‘valuable asset’
world.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian extended greetings to India on its 80th Independence Day, emphasizing the historic ties between the two nations as a "valuable asset." He noted that their longstanding relationship could contribute to building a stronger future together. The message reflects the importance of collaboration and mutual respect in the diplomatic relations between Iran and India.

business.title: BSNL is Offering Additional Validity to Prepaid Customers
business.summary: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL), India's third-largest telecom operator, has introduced a special offer for prepaid customers. This promotion provides additional validity for users recharging with select prepaid plans. The initiative aims to enhance customer satisfaction and retention by extending the duration of services. Customers are encouraged to take advantage of this offer to maximize their prepaid benefits.

business.title: Chandrasekaran’s exit puts Tata’s Air India bet under fresh scrutiny
business.summary: N. Chandrasekaran's resignation as chairman of Tata Sons has prompted scrutiny regarding Air India's future and Tata's aviation strategy. His departure marks a significant leadership change for India's largest business conglomerate, raising concerns about the direction of Air India, which is a key focus for Tata Group. The implications of this transition on the airline remain to be seen.

business.title: Chartist Talk: Is Nifty unlikely to see major downmove below 24,000 support?
business.summary: Sudeep Shah of SBI Securities stated that a decisive break outside the 24,150-24,600 range will determine the next direction for the Nifty 50 index. He noted that while market momentum has weakened, the support level at 24,000 is crucial. A significant move below this support may indicate a larger downtrend for the index.

technology.title: Marvel's Wolverine dev disturbed by criticism, as PlayStation protestors target PS5 game
technology.summary: Insomniac Games' upcoming PS5 title, Marvel's Wolverine, faces criticism on social media, with some users discouraging pre-orders. Despite largely positive previews, negative sentiments on X have gained traction. James Stevenson, the studio's Community and Marketing Director, believes that algorithms may be influencing public perception of the game. The studio aims to counteract this negativity ahead of the release.

technology.title: 'One of the most important updates': Sundar Pichai announces new Gboard feature that turns sign language into text
technology.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai has unveiled a new Gboard feature that translates American Sign Language (ASL) into text. This innovation aims to enhance communication for individuals who use sign language, enabling them to interact more effectively with smartphones and those who do not understand sign language. The feature is designed to improve accessibility and inclusivity in digital communication.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro leaks roundup: New camera, design, processor, RAM upgrade and all we know so far
technology.summary: Leaks about the iPhone 18 Pro suggest it will feature camera upgrades, a new A20 Pro chip, and increased RAM. Improved connectivity is also anticipated, alongside a higher price. While the design is not expected to change significantly from previous models, details are still emerging as the release date approaches, with further information likely to surface in the coming weeks.

sports.title: KL Rahul singled out as Yashasvi Jaiswal's ‘unfortunate’ run-out in Galle stirs the pot: ‘Wasn’t looking at all'
sports.summary: Yashasvi Jaiswal's innings ended prematurely due to a mix-up with KL Rahul during India's first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle. The incident has drawn attention, with some criticizing Rahul for not paying attention. Despite the run-out, India had a strong start, scoring 288 runs on a rain-affected opening day of the Test series.

sports.title: Bavarian Football Works
sports.summary: FC Bayern Munich faces setbacks ahead of the new season, losing three players to injuries during the Telekom Cup match against RB Leipzig. The friendlies, intended to assess player conditions and provide opportunities for less utilized team members, have turned unfortunate for the club. The injuries raise concerns about the team's readiness as the season approaches.

sports.title: Frenkie de Jong offers injury update and explains why he kept on playing at World Cup 2026
sports.summary: Frenkie de Jong provided an injury update, stating he is currently working with physical therapists on a recovery plan. He emphasized his commitment to returning to good physical condition and is focused on his rehabilitation. De Jong also explained his decision to continue playing during the World Cup 2026, highlighting the importance of teamwork and shared understanding.

health.title: From fertility to menopause, experts urge women to stop ignoring their health
health.summary: Experts at the We Women Want Conclave emphasized the importance of addressing women's health throughout all life stages, from fertility and pregnancy to menopause and preventive care. They noted that many women tend to overlook or normalize health issues, which can lead to significant long-term consequences. Increased awareness and proactive health management were urged for better outcomes.

health.title: 60% breast cancer patients diagnosed at late stages
health.summary: Sixty percent of women in India seeking treatment for breast cancer are diagnosed at late stages, according to Dr. Geeta Kadayaprath, a Surgical Oncologist at Apollo Athenaa Women’s Cancer Centre in Delhi. This statistic highlights the challenges in early detection and treatment of breast cancer in the country, emphasizing the need for improved awareness and screening initiatives.

health.title: Daily glass of fruit juice may link to lower depression scores: Study
health.summary: A study conducted in London found that consuming a daily glass of 100% fruit juice or a smoothie may be associated with lower depression scores. Over a four-week trial, participants who incorporated this into a healthier diet reported significant improvements in their mental health. The findings suggest that fruit juice may have benefits beyond just increasing fruit intake.

science.title: Astro Bob: The moon's shadow flies during solar eclipse adventure
science.summary: The author recounts a trip to Spain to witness the total solar eclipse on August 12. Co-leading a group of eclipse enthusiasts alongside Sky & Telescope magazine's senior editor Kelly Beatty, they began their journey in Barcelona. The experience highlighted the excitement and community among those who travel to observe such astronomical events.

science.title: New hairy-leafed plant species confirms another of Darwin’s predictions
science.summary: Saxifraga candelabrum, a newly identified carnivorous plant, features sticky hairs that trap small insects and flowers that emit attractive scents. This discovery supports Charles Darwin's predictions about plant evolution. To be classified as truly carnivorous, a plant must digest its prey and absorb nutrients, transforming captured insects into a valuable food source for its growth and survival.

science.title: A single compound functions as the aggregation-sex pheromone of the great capricorn beetle (Cerambyx cerdo)
science.summary: Researchers identified a male-produced aggregation-sex pheromone, (3S,4R)-3-hydroxy-p-mentha-1,8-dien-7-al, in the great capricorn beetle (Cerambyx cerdo), a conservation-priority species. This compound elicited responses from both sexes and was confirmed through various analytical methods. Field bioassays in Slovenia showed traps baited with the synthetic pheromone attracted both males and females, aiding population monitoring and conservation efforts.

entertainment.title: 'Fauzi': Anupam Kher says 'Proud to be part of this magnum opus'; Prabhas starrer gets new Independence Day poster
entertainment.summary: Prabhas's upcoming film 'Fauzi' has released a new poster in celebration of Independence Day. Directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, the movie is characterized as a period action drama. Anupam Kher expressed his pride in being part of the project, referring to it as a "magnum opus." The film aims to capture significant historical themes and narratives.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: August 16, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 16, 2026, Leos may feel mentally exhausted and guarded, having been in survival mode for an extended period. This state can lead to a default feeling of tiredness and a belief that continuous fighting is necessary to prevent further setbacks. The horoscope suggests that the cosmos has insights to offer regarding these feelings and circumstances.

entertainment.title: Aquarius Horoscope Today: August 16, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals may find clarity in their lives as things start to make sense. The pressure of adhering to a strict timeline has eased, allowing for a more natural progression. It is advised to utilize personal skills, choices, and influence wisely during this period of unfolding opportunities. Embrace the current pace and trust the process of development.
